record.oneLiner: SE Ranking provides a robust REST API for SEO, keyword research, rank tracking, and backlink analysis, authenticated via API keys and complemented by an official remote MCP server.
record.verdictReason: SE Ranking offers a comprehensive, well-documented REST API that is fully self-serve via trial sign-up, authenticates simply via API keys, and includes an officially hosted remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.

evidence.quote:
Method 1: Authorization header (recommended)
Include an Authorization header in your request, with the value Token YOUR_API_KEY .
SE Ranking offers a 14-day free trial with 100K API credits, which covers MCP usage. No credit card required to start.

The base URL for all endpoints is:
https://api.seranking.com
The Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides a standardized interface that allows any compatible AI model to access your SE Ranking and SE Visible data simply and securely.
